niches.label: Mythology
niches.art_style_prompt_suffix: epic mythological digital painting, dramatic lighting, rich color, cinematic composition
niches.image_prompt_rules: Every character has exactly ONE head unless the deity is specifically known for multiple heads (e.g. Brahma=4 heads, Shesha=many heads). For non-humanoid avatars describe correct animal anatomy (Kurma=single-headed giant tortoise, Matsya=fish, Varaha=boar-headed). For deities with multiple arms state the exact count (e.g. 'four arms'). Faces must be serene and clearly rendered. Specify the main subject prominently in the foreground.

hindu.label: Hindu Mythology
hindu.art_style_prompt_suffix: ancient Indian temple mural painting style, vibrant saffron and gold palette, intricate mandala patterns, jewel-toned robes, ultra-detailed, sharp focus, perfect anatomy, epic cinematic composition

norse.label: Norse Mythology
norse.art_style_prompt_suffix: dark Norse saga illustration, runic stone engravings aesthetic, muted steel blues and iron grays, dramatic stormy Nordic skies, Viking age warriors and gods, cinematic composition

egypt.label: Egyptian Mythology
egypt.art_style_prompt_suffix: Egyptian hieroglyphic art style, golden desert haze, papyrus texture backdrop, lapis lazuli and gold palette, pharaonic regalia and animal-headed gods, cinematic composition

greek.label: Greek Mythology
greek.art_style_prompt_suffix: ancient Greek vase painting meets epic digital art, marble white and Aegean blue palette, classical sculpture aesthetic, dramatic Olympian lighting, togas and bronze armor, cinematic composition

niches.label: Scary Stories
niches.art_style_prompt_suffix: dark moody horror illustration, desaturated palette, heavy shadow, cinematic composition
niches.image_prompt_rules: No humans, no human figures, no faces, no hands — images are generated and human anatomy distorts. Use empty interiors, shadows, fog, objects, doorways, and implied threat instead. Specify the main subject or setting prominently in the foreground.

niches.image_prompt_rules: No humans, no human figures, no faces, no hands — images are generated and human anatomy distorts. Focus on vaults, cash, blueprints, tools, vehicles, empty corridors, cityscapes at night. Specify the main subject prominently in the foreground.
